echo "=== Final line counts ===" && wc -l backend/src/routes/scenarios/index.ts backend/src/routes/cost-catalog/index.ts && echo "=== Both under 300? ===" && echo "scenarios: $(wc -l < backend/src/routes/scenarios/index.ts) lines" && echo "cost-catalog: $(wc -l < backend/src/routes/cost-catalog/index.ts) lines"
